Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You close your fist on an imagined frame. Plates and joints gather around it until your servant stands complete.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Construct entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
